policy.note: design/09 §7.1/§7.4 (D36): the pinned judge identity — a judge record produced under any other identity is invalid. Three independent attempts; per-item verdict = 2-of-3 majority; any split item is marked flaky:true and is a RUBRIC defect to tighten. Overall verdict 'fail' iff any item fails; 'na' never fails a figure. CI never invokes the judge — T-JUDGE-RECORD (WP-17) gates on committed records at figures/<figure_id>.judge.json whose spec_hash/result_hash match the current figure and whose judge identity matches this file; missing or stale → exit 3. Editing this file invalidates every record → the §7.4 re-judge ceremony (one dedicated commit, every verdict flip enumerated).

rubric.name: colour-verdict
rubric.asserts: every line's rendered colour matches its manifest-declared verdict class under the D9 mapping

rubric.name: markers
rubric.asserts: hourglass turn-point / ring apex / dot exit present per the marks setting, each on its line, none floating

rubric.name: labels
rubric.asserts: every callout anchored at its declared anchor; none floating, clipped, or swallowed

rubric.name: sight grammar
rubric.asserts: when occluders are present: dashed rays from each line's eye to its limit point; occluded region shaded

rubric.name: mistake legibility
rubric.asserts: each mistake-role line visually reads as the error it teaches (the one genuinely judgmental item)

rubric.name: projection disclosure
rubric.asserts: diagram mode only: disclosure note present; the compressed figure still reads physically sensible
rubric.applies: diagram mode only — na on every v0.1 (true-mode) figure

rubric.name: no fabrication
rubric.asserts: nothing drawn that the manifest doesn't declare

rubric.name: legibility floor
rubric.asserts: lines distinguishable and text readable at the 2x raster

rubric.name: fan disclosure
rubric.asserts: a drawn continuation fan carries its disclosure; a cross-tick beyond FAN_DRAW_M renders clamped with the truncated hatch
rubric.applies: D45 render promotion only — absent from v0.1 judging

standing_sentence: a failing line's endpoint must sit at its termination — never wandering in the grass, never exiting the frame uncropped
